items.name: CubeChella 2018
items.information: * **The cost of registration is a $20 flat fee. Payments are taken after registering. We will not be taking registrations or payments at the door.** * Fees will go towards the Palm Desert Church of Christ Youth Group and the use of the venue. * Spectating is free and open the the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY.** * Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks! * **Additional Information** * Please be respectful of the venue and do not go into rooms that are not included for the competition. We wish to keep the venue as clean as possible; doing this will guarantee use of venue for future competitions and will ease the clean up process after the competition ends.

items.name: Fewest Moves Christmas 2018
items.information: Den eneste disciplin der vil blive afholdt til denne konkurrence er 3x3x3 i Færrest Træk! Der vil være pauser mellem de tre forsøg, hvor vi kan have noget julesjov. Vi vil lave pakkeleg, hvor det er muligt at deltage, hvis man medbringer en lille gave. Efter konkurrencen vil det være muligt at blive og hygge til klokken 20:00. Frokost og julesnacks vil blive serveret i løbet af dagen og er en del af detagergebyret. Det vil også være muligt at få aftensmad, men det vil koste ekstra :) ____ The only event which will be held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves! There will be breaks between the attempts where we can have some Christmas fun. One of these activities will be "Pakkeleg" where you can bring a small gift if you wish to participate. After the competition it will be possible to stay for hygge until 20:00. Lunch and Christmas snacks will be provided in the registration fee. Dinner is optional and will cost extra :)

items.information: * This is not your normal competition. If you have not competed before, you are welcome to attend, but this is not the best competition for your first experience. The competition is open to spectators at no charge. * Please be quiet. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. * Competitors should expect to judge. Depending on the number of competitors who enter and the expected times per BLD attempt, the organisation team will schedule everyone's individual BLD attempts to give the competition a nice, clear structure. When you are not scheduled to compete (this includes FMCers), please be available to judge BLD attempts. IMPORTANT! In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate. For further information, please send an email to [Wilson Alvis](mailto:walvisc54@gmail.com).
